 Duro XXL returns to Montmeló on 26 and 27 March 2027 with a private presale, and Black Hangar comes first with makina and hard techno
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Clara Belmonte 
 12 Nov 2026, 11:00 
 A 2-minute read 
 Duro Festival / Gisela Jane 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Duro XXL returns to Montmeló on 26 and 27 March 2027 , with more than 60 artists across three stages, although no names have been announced for the line-up yet. 
 The first passes are only on sale through a private presale : for previous attendees and for anyone who registers on the website; general sale is closed and the price has not been published. 
 Black Hangar comes first, on 5 and 6 December : makina with Pastis, Buenri and Sisu on Saturday and hard techno with Adrián Mills and Cloudy on Sunday, with a two-day pass at €60. 
 Duro Festival has set the date for its next big-format event. Duro XXL returns to Montmeló on 26 and 27 March 2027 , five months after the October edition, and has opened a private presale for anyone who has attended before or who registers. Before that, the same team closes the year with Black Hangar , two days of electronic music on 5 and 6 December at Espai Can Guitet, with the line-up already complete.
 Duro XXL 2027: 26 and 27 March in Montmeló
 The official website describes the March event as ‘the festival’s biggest format to date’: two days, more than 60 artists and three stages , with international showcases . No names or set times have been announced yet, and the website only places the event in Montmeló, without specifying the venue.
 The previous XXL edition took place on 10 and 11 October, with Klangkuenstler and Kobosil among the headliners, as we reported in our guide to Duro Festival XXL 2026 .
 The Black Hangar, Duro Festival’s tent in Montmeló. Image: Duro Festival / Gisela Jane How to get tickets for Duro XXL 2027
 Right now the only route is the private presale . According to the festival’s website, anyone who has attended Duro before has received an email with the purchase link; those who have never been can sign up via the presale form on the official website , which asks for name, email, postcode and age.
 The organisers describe the first passes as being at a ‘super-reduced price’, but have not published the amount , and warn that general sale for Duro XXL 2027 is closed for now. The festival advises against buying on any platform other than its website and Enterticket, its official ticketing partner.
 Black Hangar 2026: makina on Saturday and hard techno on Sunday
 Black Hangar, billed as ‘powered by Duro’, takes over Espai Can Guitet on Saturday 5 and Sunday 6 December . Each day has its own line-up:
 Saturday 5, Universo Makina: Pastis, Buenri and Sisu together, Héctor Oaks as DJ Kaos11, Cristian Varela, Carlos Pérez with K-Style, and Nhymph.
 Sunday 6, 240 km/h: Adrián Mills, Kuko, Clara Cuvé, Cloudy, Nikolina, Aerea live, GIØ, Human Error, Carnada, H1pnos1s with Quince, Anna Jevills, Ines Isla and Fobia.
 240 km/h is the same brand that organised this summer’s 240 Back Home in Salou. Second-phase tickets cost €60 for the two-day pass and €45 per day , VAT included, from the shop on the official website and from Enterticket , which lists doors opening at 11:00. Anyone aged 18 with the Bono Cultural Joven can use it towards the purchase, according to the festival’s website. If you are looking for more plans for that long weekend, you will find them in our December festival listings .
 Sources: official Duro Festival website (home page and Duro XXL 2027 presale page) and the Black Hangar 2026 event page on Enterticket, consulted on 12 November 2026; Festivalote, on the Duro XXL 2027 dates; previous ModoFestival coverage.
